description.p: Lithidion connects your Pebble watch to your Linux phone, tablet, or computer over Bluetooth, with no account and no cloud.

ul.li: Pairs with Pebble watches
Keeps the watch connected in the background and sets its clock
More than one watch, each with its own settings, switched with a tap
Installs and updates PebbleOS
Watchfaces and apps from the Pebble and Rebble app stores
Notifications and calls on the watch
Calendar events, weather, and music controls
Steps, sleep, and heart rate, kept on the device
Dictation for watch apps, transcribed on the device
Advanced tools for the connection, restarts, and recovery firmware

description.p: Not affiliated with Core Devices or Pebble.

ul.li: Adds and pairs Pebble watches, and switches between them
Connects over both kinds of Pebble Bluetooth connection, and reconnects on its own
Keeps the watch connected from a small background service while the window is closed
Sets the watch's clock and time zone, and keeps them in step
Shows the watch's battery, firmware, and details
Installs PebbleOS on a new watch and offers updates
Watchfaces and apps from the Pebble and Rebble app stores
Notifications with Dismiss and Mute, and calls with the caller's name
Notifications missed while the watch was away, sent when it reconnects
Pictures in notifications, on watches that show them
Calendar events on the timeline, weather, and music controls
Health: steps, sleep, heart rate, activities, and the wearer's profile, by week, month, or year, and each day hour by hour
Dictation, transcribed on the device
Advanced: connection details, ping, restart, recovery firmware, and saving the watch's log and core dump
